summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of German law firm website (ICMN & Partner) after major code refactoring. All features tested successfully: Home page sections, navigation, service pages, legal pages, cookie consent, mobile menu, and back-to-top button.
critical_code_review_comments: Code refactoring from 862 lines to 8 section components is well done
All data-testid attributes properly implemented for testing
Navigation spacing with gap-8 works correctly
Cookie consent localStorage persistence working as expected
